title: How John Rush built a $3.5M ARR AI agent portfolio with no VC and tiny teams
summary: John Rush explains his bootstrapped studio model: he builds the first MVP, pairs with a 50/50 co-maker, and holds every product forever as part of a cross-promoting ecosystem. SEO Bot reached about $120K MRR with two people. He also covers his growth split, pricing ladder and SEO backlink advice.

principles.text: Hold products forever; even non-earning tools work as marketing channels that feed the rest of the ecosystem.
principles.quote: they act as marketing channels for me. Like I have directories. I have like 25 or 35 directories right now. Like a lot of them and most of them make no revenue. But they drive traffic to all my other tools.

principles.text: Start pricing low with builders as first customers, then raise the price and move to teams once they love it.
principles.quote: I usually start with smaller check just that my first customers are the builders because I like to build product for builders first because they give me good feedback and they actually become part of my product team and once I get to a place where they love it then I increase the price

principles.text: Show how your own tools help you, and share the results publicly. It markets both products.
principles.quote: I show everybody how the tool is helping myself, right? So uh in case of SEO bot I use it for all my other products and then I share the results and that helps a lot

principles.text: Growth split: about 30% SEO, 30% cross-promo across products with one audience, 30% build-in-public social, 10% other.
principles.quote: So 30% SEO, 30% crossromo, and 30% is social media where I build in public and other people share uh that they use my product too.

principles.text: Talk directly to users at scale; fast fixes make them loyal and turn them into ambassadors.
principles.quote: I spend time to listen to the users and I have chats going on with a lot of the users. I don't think anyone on earth has more chats than me.

principles.text: To win a specific SERP, build exact-anchor backlinks to that exact URL and add many internal links.
principles.quote: the most typical serious work you can do on SEO is to take page by page and just try to win against competitors using backlinks to that exact page.
